webhooks.detail: Webhook subscriptions via API; trigger on object type + action events from the Event Log, with filters and HMAC signatures

evidence.quote: Webhooks allow a subscription URL to be configured that we will POST event data to as it is added to the Event Log.

evidence.quote: Rate limits are enforced per endpoint group.
